description: Compute the canonical stable coloring of a small unlabeled simple undirected graph by 1-dimensional Weisfeiler-Lehman refinement.

source.title: weisfeiler_lehman_graph_hash method description
source.algorithm_attribution: Initialize unlabeled nodes with degree colors, aggregate each node's own color and sorted neighbor-color multiset, and canonically compress signatures each round.
source.implementation_status: bounded hash-free color-refinement core; no digest output

contract.operation: Return the canonical stable 1-WL color of each vertex, packed in base 9 with vertex 0 as the least-significant digit.
contract.graph_constraints: Simple undirected graph: masks fit in N bits, have no diagonal bits, and are symmetric.
contract.initialization: Use each vertex's degree as its initial color, matching the unlabeled graph convention.
contract.refinement: For each vertex form (current_color, sorted multiset of neighbor colors), sort distinct signatures lexicographically, and assign their zero-based ranks.
contract.stopping_rule: Stop after a round that does not increase the number of color classes; return that round's canonical colors.
contract.output_encoding: Sum color[v]*9^v for all vertices; N is provided by the input.
contract.independent_method: Explicitly split ordered partition blocks by sorted neighbor-color multisets until no block splits.

output.encoding: stable per-vertex canonical colors packed in base 9

workspace.meaning: Fixed adjacency-mask, degree, color, and signature storage for at most eight vertices.
